description: This file contains Cypress end-to-end tests for the sidebar navigation and theme toggle functionality of a web application. It tests the navigation between different pages (`/reports`, `/users`, `/charts`) with highlighting of the active link and verifies the theme toggle button.

methods.name: beforeEach
methods.description: Setup hook that mocks API responses, visits the login page, and performs login via UI before each test case.

methods.name: it('navigates between Reports, Users, and Charts with active highlight')
methods.description: Test that navigates through the reports, users, and charts pages, verifying the URL and active navigation highlighting

methods.name: it('theme toggle switches icon (basic smoke)')
methods.description: Test that clicks on the theme toggle button and verifies its existence
